sourceAnchors.evidence: struct battle declares the 13x13 grid, distance byte, before/after messages, and battle macro.
CvtBattleToPc converts grid shorts and message/macro shorts.
Combat loads Data BD by abs(battlenum) * sizeof battle.
Battle grid entries resolve monsters through abs(value) into Data MD.
Negative grid values flip the loaded monster side/friendly flag.
Negative battlemacro activates a macro at combat-round boundaries.

layout.editorMeaning: monster placement grid; 0 empty, abs(value) Data MD id, negative flips side
alignment padding; fresh/authored rows emit zero and unchanged imported rows retain legacy bytes only through the compatibility annex
Data SD2 message shown before combat
Data SD2 message shown after combat
combat-round macro/door reference with sign-sensitive behavior

runtimeBehaviors: Battle IDs are loaded by abs(battlenum).
messageafter is copied to runtime messageafter for post-battle handling.
dist is randomized using Rand(dist) before initial monster placement.
Each nonzero grid cell creates a monster until maxmon.
Grid cell abs(value) is the Data MD monster record index.
Negative grid cell values flip the loaded monster side/friendly flag.
Negative battlemacro values activate combat-round macro execution.

corpusEvidence.presence: Data BD appears in all 44 analyzed scenarios. Four additional 32-byte .finf payloads are Finder metadata companions, not battle tables.
